subject: 🏃 Monday — Hip Complex Circuit (Wk 7, Presidio Pivot Week)
html:
Tomorrow: Hip Complex Circuit — two rounds, bodyweight only, ~20 minutes. This is mobility, not a lift. Keep it genuinely light; you're recovering from yesterday's 14.23-mile long run (suffer 231, 82% Z3, +936 ft), the biggest session of the V6 plan so far. The circuit opens Week 7 — Presidio HM pivot week. Everything this week protects freshness for Sunday's race.

The circuit (2 rounds): foam roller T-spine extensions (8–10 reps) · standing lunges w/ hip IR + extension (8–10 each side) · quadruped banded hip IR (5–10 each side, PT) · 90/90 switches (8–10 each side) · adductor rockbacks (8–10) · quadruped hip CARs (3 each direction, each leg — slow, sink into IR) · half-kneeling couch stretch (60 sec each side).

Focus cue: Treat this as a flush, not a workout. Sink slowly into each movement, breathe through the hip IR positions, don't force range. Yesterday's hilly long run loaded the quads and hip flexors with eccentric work — the circuit is designed to decompress exactly that. If anything feels tight or restricted vs. last Monday, note it.

Where you are: Week 7 of 12, Phase 2. 6 days to the Presidio Half Marathon pivot test (June 21). The three gates: sub-1:37:30 finish, avg HR <170 final 3 mi, zero knee compensation. Yesterday's long run says the engine is ready — you held 5 MP miles at HR 150–156 on tired hilly legs with the knee at 1/5 and gut handling all 4 gels. The week's only quality session is Tuesday's trimmed 3×1600m sharpener; everything else stays easy. Rest well tonight — the 14-miler earned it.
